purpose: Record the owner-requested 15/30-turn SEIS sub-agent swarm cadence as a supervised, repo-local planning ledger without granting continuous background runtime, external mutation, credential access, SSH, cloud, model training, routeable inference, benchmark, or AGI authority.
truthBoundary: This ledger is a supervised planning and evidence contract. It does not prove uninterrupted five-year execution, always-on background agents, completed 720B training, routeable 720B inference, AGI capability, cloud/GPU provisioning, SSH execution, provider calls, credential access, deployment, GitHub mutation, or production readiness.

roundAssignments.focus: Confirm current source-of-truth files, AGENTS alignment, and active writer boundary before any scoped work.
Scan planned scope for secrets, unsafe autonomy, SSH/cloud execution, provider key, and fake AGI claims.
Wire one bounded MCP or source-of-truth improvement with disjoint file ownership.
Run the narrowest reliable validators for the changed surface before expanding test scope.
Regenerate repo-local evidence and update public-safe handoff text for the changed surface.
Review icon-first, calm, accessible presentation needs for any demo-facing artifact.
Map provider/router/model changes to plan-only source files before any runtime claim.
Advance local-demo, no-key, or MCP-read surface without adding credentials or dependencies casually.
Review prompt-injection, public/private boundary, and destructive-command safety before handoff.
Run MCP smoke or demo smoke checks when the resource/tool/browser surface changes.
Update generated reports, roadmap notes, and next safe action without overstating completion.
Keep SEIS Command Center direction icon-first, Apple-first, cinematic calm, and not generic SaaS.
Advance the 720B frontier target only through evidence ladders and AGI evaluation gates.
Replay claim-safety, JSON parse, diff, and focused whitespace checks for touched files.
Close the 15-round window with an AGENTS-format report and a next-round handoff.

expandedRounds16To30.allowedUse: Split larger work into disjoint implementation, validation, docs, design, security, and architecture packages after the first 15-round window is reviewed.
